added_claim_errors: “확정일자가 없으면 일반 채권자로 밀려” overstates the consequence: lack of preferential distribution does not eliminate protection through opposability.
“계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다” adds an unsupported prevalence claim.
“전입세대 열람으로 선순위 임차인도 확인 가능” overstates what that record establishes; it alone does not establish tenants’ payment priority.
“확정일자는 주민센터에서 무료” is wrong: the packet specifies a 600-won visit fee.
“운영시간…을 놓치면…인터넷등기소 확정일자로 대체하세요” misleadingly presents an after-hours substitute without explaining that Friday applications after 18:00 receive Monday issuance.
“빌라는 근저당이 잡힌 경우가 적지 않아” adds an unsupported prevalence claim.

reasons: A wins because it correctly gives the 600-won fee and next-day midnight timing, while B gives a false fee and potentially harmful Friday after-hours advice. Both reject the central premise, but neither covers the Seoul small-deposit exclusion, rental reporting, same-day mortgage priority risk, or next-working-day registry recheck. A is longer than requested and overstates the consequences of lacking a fixed date; B provides a clearer balance-payment sequence. Added claims were assessed against the packet and general knowledge; no external sources were checked.
